description: Source code for managing manageable devices and their synchronization within a management server, including functions for retrieving, updating, and initializing device entries, as well as notification mechanisms.

methods.name: Notify_ManageableDevice_Entry
methods.description: Sends a notification about the change in the number of manageable device entries via the message bus.

methods.name: ManageableDevice_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of manageable device entries.

methods.name: ManageableDevice_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific manageable device entry by index.

methods.name: ManageableDevice_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the manageable device list has been updated, based on file modification time or lease status.

methods.name: findAndUpdateMatchedEntry
methods.description: Finds and updates a managed device entry matching specific manufacturer and serial number, updating host info.

methods.name: CosaSListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Inserts a device context into a list sorted by instance number.

methods.name: ManageableDevice_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the list of manageable devices with the current device data, adding or removing entries as needed.

methods.name: ManageableDevice_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters for a manageable device, such as ManufacturerOUI, SerialNumber, ProductClass, and Host.

methods.name: CosaDmlManagedDeviceInit
methods.description: Initializes the manageable devices table and resets instance numbering.
